## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Theory</th><td class="big">69</td><td>Three module tests, 23 marks each. Each test evaluates conceptual understanding and problem-solving aligned with its module.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Laboratory</th><td class="big">21</td><td>Three lab evaluations, 7 marks each. Assessment covers lab performance, code quality, a viva or demo, submissions and written quizzes.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Attendance</th><td class="big">10</td><td>Recorded on the biometric system. It is your responsibility to make sure it registers; unrecorded attendance counts as an absence regardless of physical presence.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

### Attendance {#attendance}

```{=html}
<table class="t att" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Absences</th><th>Marks</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>≤ 4</td><td>10</td></tr><tr><td>5</td><td>9</td></tr><tr><td>6</td><td>8</td></tr><tr><td>7</td><td>7</td></tr><tr><td>8</td><td>6</td></tr><tr><td>9</td><td>3</td></tr><tr><td>10</td><td>2</td></tr><tr><td>&gt; 10</td><td>0</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

### Policies {#policies}

**Leave requests.** There is no leave request system. Any missed class registers as an absence; you do not need to notify the instructor or submit medical documentation for individual absences.

**Exceptional circumstances.** If an emergency requires four or more consecutive absences, discuss special consideration with the instructor directly.

:::
